def test_get_closest_vowel():
    # Basic: rightmost interior vowel surrounded by consonants
    assert get_closest_vowel("yogurt") == "u"
    assert get_closest_vowel("FULL") == "U"
    assert get_closest_vowel("string") == "i"
    assert get_closest_vowel("cat") == "a"
    assert get_closest_vowel("cupid") == "i"  # rightmost wins over "u"

    # Too short
    assert get_closest_vowel("") == ""
    assert get_closest_vowel("a") == ""
    assert get_closest_vowel("ab") == ""

    # No qualifying vowel
    assert get_closest_vowel("quick") == ""  # adjacent vowels
    assert get_closest_vowel("queue") == ""  # adjacent vowels
    assert get_closest_vowel("apple") == ""  # vowels only at edges
    assert get_closest_vowel("bcdfg") == ""  # no vowels
